mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies and a temperature of 35 degrees at Verona Community Park. The waxing crescent moon is visible, and please note that while there is an ISS pass tonight, you will not be able to see it due to the clouds.

City Hall is busy with election notices and the Plan Commission reviewing site plans for Sub-Zero in the Liberty Business Park. Additionally, remember that the Municipal Court is available for handling citations, though O W I cases require personal attention.

There is a lot to do this week. Today, catch live music at Bailey Run Vineyard. Tomorrow, enjoy the Dane County Farmers Market in Madison or live music at Paddy Mac's. On Saturday, take in the music of John Denver at the Verona Area High School Fine Arts Center.

In a noteworthy call from October 25, the Verona Police Department responded to a report of a vehicle stopped at an intersection where a man was found behind the wheel and subsequently arrested for an O W I.
Stop by Culver's of Verona today to enjoy our featured flavor of the day, Raspberry Cheesecake. We are open and serving until 10:30 PM, so come visit us soon.
